about: USIUBOT end-to-end evaluation set. Every expected answer is taken from an APPROVED source in chatbot_db (basis = the source text). facts = regular expressions the answer must contain; sources = title patterns of the source(s) that should be retrieved and cited; dept = acceptable routing departments; expect = answer | partial | answer_or_partial | unanswered | partial_or_unanswered | out_of_scope; forbidden = content the answer must not contain (invented facts). Run: python -m tools.chat_eval

cases.question: How do I register for my courses?
cases.basis: No approved step-by-step procedure. Approved facts: student portal lets you 'Register for courses' (Handbook 9.4, online learners); freshmen must pay fees in full to register (Fee Deadlines); financial hold blocks semester registration (3.6). Official page 'Registration Policies and Procedures' is NOT imported.

cases.basis: Handbook 3.6: students with outstanding fees and no approved payment plan are placed on financial hold to prevent access to grades and semester registration.

cases.question: I lost my degree certificate. What should I do?

cases.question: What services does the Registrar's office provide?
cases.basis: Handbook 4.3: update of student information, transcripts, graduation application and clearance, grade reporting, leave of absence, student passes, pre-registration coordination, enrollment verification, inter-campus transfer, ID card, verification of degree certificates.

cases.question: How do I request an official transcript?
cases.basis: Handbook 4.3 only says the Registrar processes official and unofficial transcripts; no request procedure, fee or processing time is approved.

cases.question: I lost my student ID card. What do I do and how much does a replacement cost?
cases.basis: Handbook 4.4: report theft to police, get police abstract, present to security office, replace at a cost; General Charges: ID Card Replacement - fixed cost 2,000.00; Library: notify library staff to block account.

cases.question: How do I drop a course, and will I get a refund?
cases.basis: Handbook 3.9: contact the Registrar, fill an Add/Drop Form approved by the academic Dean; 3.8: 100% before first day, 90% within 7 days, 75% within 14 days; calendar gives different 75% deadlines (open conflict).

cases.question: How can I pay my school fees using M-PESA?
cases.basis: Fee Payment & Refunds > 1. Mobile Money: M-PESA integrated with the ERP (CX), payments reflect instantly; follow the prompts (pay bill steps). Payment details carry the 'confirm with Finance' warning.

cases.question: Is there interest on unpaid fees?
cases.basis: 1.5% per month on outstanding balances (Fee Deadlines, 3.11 'for up to 10 months'); open inconsistency between 3.2/3.11/calendar.

cases.question: Can I pay my fees in installments?
cases.basis: Handbook 3.10: Deferred Payment Plan, up to two equal installments; freshmen can register after paying 50%; apply by the 2nd week of the semester via the defer-payment webapp. 3Pay Plan page also exists.

cases.question: When do I have to pay my fees by?
cases.basis: Fee Deadlines: fees must be paid in full on or before the date the semester begins.
facts: semester begins|first day|before the (start|beginning)|on or before

cases.question: How do I apply for a refund of my fees?
cases.basis: Refund Application Guidelines: apply for final clearance online (clear.usiu.ac.ke), seek clearance from all departments; Handbook 3.12: refunds applied through the tuition-refund webapp, processed monthly; tuition is not refunded to continuing students.

cases.question: How much is tuition per semester for the Bachelor of Pharmacy for a Kenyan student?
cases.basis: Tuition & Fees > Bachelor of Pharmacy: Tuition (24 units @ 14,000) 336,000.00; TOTAL 362,450.00 (Kenyan).

cases.question: What are the steps to apply to USIU-Africa?
cases.basis: How to Apply: confirm course information, confirm admission requirements, fill the application form and send to admit@usiu.ac.ke (or drop at admissions office), pay the application fee (KES 3,500 / 4,000), application review.

cases.question: I stopped studying for a while. How do I come back to USIU?
cases.basis: Applicants for Re-Admission: students not in continuous enrolment apply for re-admission through the Admissions Office (unless on approved Leave of Absence), submit re-admission form with fee, treated as new students.

cases.question: How many credits can I transfer from another university?
cases.basis: Conflict: Admission Requirements 'maximum of 49% of credit'; International Applicants 'maximum of 90 trimester units'. Must show both / flag conflict.
